We got a result list with one template. It includes mapped_rxn, template_hash, etc. Need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The result includes 'reaction_id' maybe that's the template ID? The description says template_id is integer used to search the database not the hash. Likely reaction_id is the template ID. So template_id = 1914385.

We need to return dict with mapped_rxn string and template_id integer.

The mapped_rxn provided: '[CH2:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH2:9].[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1=[CH:10][C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]1>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C@:5]12[CH2:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH2:9][C@H:10]1[C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]2'

Check that this matches target molecule? The target SMILES is COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. The product side of mapped_rxn is that? Let's compare: product SMILES in result: '[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C@:5]12[CH2:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH2:9][C@H:10]1[C:11](=[O:12])[CH2:13]2' which corresponds to COC(=O)C... yes matches.

Thus answer.

Return JSON dict.
